thread:
alyssa: Quick convo — thinking through combining CB signals for SLO-driven routing + fallback UX in Console. We currently compute p95 latency, in-flight queue depth, and upstream model error rate separately. Want a simple aggregator that drives fallback to cheaper model variant or regional failover. How do we score & expose this in the API/Console?

ben: +1. we need something deterministic and explainable to SREs and customers. simple linear score is fine to start. weights + thresholds that map to actions (soft-fallback, hard-fallback, reject).

chandra: agree on linear. also add an exponential moving window for latency so spikes don’t trigger immediate hard-fallback. maybe p95 over 1m and 5m windows.

dmitri: FWIW telemetry needs to include contributing signal breakdown per decision so we can surface why a fallback happened. e.g., {latency:0.6, queue:0.3, error:0.1} + raw metrics.

elaine: Console UX: show current score, primary contributing metric, and a small timeline sparkline. Allow operators to override weight sliders and set per-tier presets (startup, business, enterprise).

alyssa: +ops/telemetry asks. Also thinking about per-customer SLO targets as inputs into scoring. e.g., enterprise has p95 target 200ms, startup 500ms — normalize latency score by target so same raw latency maps differently by tier.

ben: yes normalize. proposed formula: score = w1*(latency_ms / tier_p95_target) + w2*(queue / queue_cap) + w3*(error_rate_normalized). clamp to [0,1]. action when score > threshold.

chandra: Also need hysteresis: min_duration_before_action and cooldown period. otherwise we flip-flop during a noisy period.

dmitri: sample config draft (was posted quickly):
```yaml
cb_policy:
  version: 1
  weights: {latency: 0.5, queue: 0.35, error: 0.15}
  windows: {latency_short: 60, latency_long: 300}
  thresholds: {soft: 0.5, hard: 0.8}
  hysteresis: {min_time_s: 30, cooldown_s: 120}
  actions: {soft: fallback_to_variant, hard: route_to_region_fallback}
```

elaine: console API idea: POST /routing/policies/{id}/evaluate returns {score, contributors, recommended_action, reason_codes}. UI can call this for a hover preview during rollout.

alyssa: +1 for eval endpoint. We should also expose an explainable reason code set: [LATENCY_DOMINANT, QUEUE_PRESSURE, ERROR_SPIKE, TIER_MISMATCH].

ben: Ops question — how do we reconcile model variant compatibility? fallback only if variant is semantically compatible. need a model-compatibility registry and graceful degradation policy (truncate tools, lower tokens, quantized variant, etc.).

chandra: compatibility check should be a separate precondition. policy evaluation returns recommended_action but engine must verify compatibility and fallback options sorted by ranking.

dmitri: telemetry/event payload sketch for rollouts:
```json
{
  "ts":"$now",
  "customer_id":"abc123",
  "policy_id":"cb-v1",
  "score":0.72,
  "contributors":{"latency":0.48,"queue":0.18,"error":0.06},
  "action":"soft-fallback",
  "selected_variant":"gpt-2-quant",
  "compatibility_checked":true
}
```

elaine: For rollout UX we want a canary slider + percentage buckets, and a simulation mode that shows expected fallback rate given historical traces. That will help customers tune thresholds before enabling.

alyssa: action items: 1) eng-platform to prototype the linear scoring and eval endpoint (dmitri + chandra). 2) console to add preview API and weight sliders (elaine). 3) product to draft tier normalization defaults (ben + alyssa). 4) ops-bot to log a follow-up incident playbook template for fallback events.

ops-bot: noted. Created ticket #PLAT-4987 and scheduled sync Wed 10am PT. :calendar:

ben: one more note — make threshold presets conservative for hosted tier by default, allow enterprise to opt into aggressive. we want safety-first. :lock:

chandra: will add unit tests and a small sim harness to validate no more than X% false positive immediate fallbacks in 1d trace.

alyssa: perfect — thanks everyone. I'll drop a short RFC with config schema and wireframes after the sync. :sparkles:
